name: verify-integrate
deprecation_criterion: Superseded when the loop adopts a non-git VCS backend, or a model-backed verify/integrate policy replaces the deterministic gh-based gates, or when the Verdict / IntegrationResult / ReviewVerdict / ReconcileResult schemas reach a breaking major version.
spec_change_reason: v0.25.3 hotfix: RECONCILE's (B) conflict-recovery ladder silently missed a genuinely-conflicting loop PR because gh_pr_state_source did not resolve a transient mergeable=UNKNOWN (VERIFY's gh_open_pr_source got that poll in v0.25.1). Right after a sibling PR merges and invalidates a loop PR, GitHub reports mergeable=UNKNOWN transiently, so _reconcile_one's (B) branch (which requires mergeable=='CONFLICTING' exactly) skipped it. FIX: gh_pr_state_source(pr_ref, repo, runner, sleep) now, when the PR is OPEN and NOT merged and mergeable=='UNKNOWN', calls the EXISTING poll_mergeability(number, repo, runner, sleep) — the same bounded poll VERIFY uses (MERGEABILITY_POLL_ATTEMPTS / MERGEABILITY_POLL_INTERVAL_S) — to re-query until the value settles to MERGEABLE/CONFLICTING or the bounded attempts exhaust, returning that settled mergeable. A MERGED PR short-circuits (no poll — merge state is final); a still-UNKNOWN result is returned as-is (defers to the next tick). _reconcile_one and the (A)/(B)/(C) logic are UNCHANGED — the seam now returns a settled value; RECONCILE stays advisory + fault-isolated. Housekeep doc baseline re-anchored (spec.md 537 -> 553).
spec_no_change_reason: spec.md already updated + committed on this branch (415fd5d) with the v0.25.3 gh_pr_state_source transient-UNKNOWN bounded-poll seam clarification + the extended RECONCILE convergence invariant; this cycle implements them in src + tests
